name: meta-research-agent
description: Codex skills for neurosurgical systematic reviews and meta-analysis workflows

interface.shortDescription: Systematic-review and meta-analysis workflows for medical research.
interface.longDescription: A Codex-native port of Meta Agent's research skills for literature-search planning, structured extraction, risk-of-bias assessment, conventional and network meta-analysis, trial sequential analysis, and PRISMA manuscript drafting.
defaultPrompt: Build a PRISMA-ready systematic review workflow for my research question.
Help me plan and validate a meta-analysis from this study dataset.
Assess risk of bias for these included studies.
